tenderSchedule.title: Providing Catering Services to Pourakarmikas Morning Breakfast at TP Somwarpet
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Catering Services to Pourakarmikas Morning Breakfast at TP Somwarpet

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed as prime Supplier/tenderer, at least one similar goods and services such as Providing Catering Services and/or running canteen of value not less than Rs. 1.35 Lakhs in the last five years
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have Registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities

The tenderer/firms/individuals should have minimum 3 years of experience in the field of cooking and catering/ Canteen Services. An Affidavit duly signed by the concerned notary should be uploaded, otherwise tender will be rejected
